name: The Coca-Cola Company
blurb: The Coca-Cola Company manufactures and sells nonalcoholic beverages worldwide, including sparkling soft drinks, water, sports drinks, coffee, tea, juice, dairy, and plant-based beverages. It is one of the largest beverage companies globally, with a market capitalization of approximately $340 billion. The company's brand portfolio includes Coca-Cola, Diet Coke, and other well-known labels.
recent: As of May 6, 2026, KO stock closed at $79.23, up 0.96% on the day, with a 52-week range of $65.35–$82.00. The company reported strong earnings on April 28, 2026, with net income up 27% year-over-year to $13.70 billion and EPS of $3.18. Analysts maintain a Strong Buy consensus with a price target of $85.06.
